verdict.rationale: First-party docs claim 'world-class documentation' and list Tutorial and Examples sections, and an llms.txt is served for AI consumption. That gives glancing support for exploring documented APIs with examples. Nothing in the pack shows the examples are runnable or that the API reference is interactive. The OpenAPI 404 is irrelevant, since Vue is a framework rather than an HTTP API. Missing for 10: evidence of runnable or editable in-browser examples (e.g. a playground), an interactive API reference, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
